title: A project wildcard include never matches files of an imported project
rule: An include starting with / only matches files of the current project, never files of imported projects.

citations.quote: Absolute path starting from current project's root.
To include a file from another project, use the filename with two forward slashes (//)

rationale: Imported project files are reached through // includes. The suite places them under imported_projects/<name>/, the folder the IDE shows them in, which a / wildcard must not match.
